shorts.hook: You will not be moved tonight.
shorts.title: A Peaceful Prayer Before Sleep

rubric.reasons: Starts strong with a firm statement of security. Great flow into a bedtime blessing.
rubric.hook_line: You will not be moved tonight.
rubric.title: A Peaceful Prayer Before Sleep

shorts.text: You will not be moved. Lord, as sleep comes, I place myself completely in your hands. My body, my mind, my heart, my family, my tomorrow. Watch over me through the night, and wake me to your mercy in the morning. And now receive this blessing as you sleep. Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all. Sleep well, in the shelter of his love. In Jesus' name, amen.

shorts.hook: Do not carry guilt into sleep.
shorts.title: Lay Your Head Down Clean Tonight

rubric.reasons: Tackles guilt and regret directly, offering a profound sense of a clean slate for sleep.
rubric.hook_line: Do not carry guilt into sleep.
rubric.title: Lay Your Head Down Clean Tonight

shorts.text: Father, I also bring you what I regret. The impatient word. The thing I should have done and did not. The moment I chose myself over someone else. I do not want to carry guilt into my sleep. I confess it to you honestly, and I receive your forgiveness. If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. Faithful and just. God does not forgive you reluctantly. He forgives you because he promised he would, and he always keeps his promises. So tonight you can lay your head down clean.

shorts.title: Jesus Promises Rest For Your Soul

rubric.reasons: The distinction between resting the body and resting the soul is a powerful emotional hook.
rubric.title: Jesus Promises Rest For Your Soul

shorts.text: You can hold them while I sleep. Jesus said, Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light. Jesus promises rest for your souls. Sleep can rest your body, but only he can rest the part of you that keeps running even when your eyes are closed. He is gentle and humble in heart.
